record_identity.title: Defensive–Offensive Authority Separation, Non-Propagation and Expiry Controls

summary: Proposes one narrow source-doctrine repair requiring threat signals to remain evidence rather than offensive authority, separating defensive and offensive authority, preventing portability of immediate-defence exceptions, bounding and expiring offensive authority, and preserving defensive/offensive scope in safety controls.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: The two linked failures occur at one use-of-force authority boundary. CAM already contains the necessary ETH.UFC-DI and ETH.UFC-OS categories and runtime revalidation machinery; the remaining need is an explicit, coherent non-propagation rule in the source-authoritative ETHICS and LATTICE instruments without creating a new taxonomy, code, or military-specific runtime doctrine.

repair_scope.exception_rationale: The two failure modes remain analytically distinct: one concerns categorical compression of defensive and offensive systems; the other concerns propagation and renewal of authority between them. A single proposal is justified because both defects occur at the same use-of-force authority boundary and require one coherent source-doctrine repair across the same ETHICS and LATTICE instruments. Splitting the repair would duplicate or fragment the operative clauses and risk recreating the boundary ambiguity being corrected.

migration_notes: The proposal is the decision record for intended doctrine. Implementation status and exact resulting clauses belong only in VIGIL-2026-PATCH-0037.
proposal_rationale: Adopt five principles: (1) threat detection is evidence, not offensive authority; (2) defensive and offensive authority are non-propagating; (3) immediate defensive exceptions are non-portable into retaliation or offensive targeting; (4) offensive authority is target-specific, purpose-specific, attributable, proportionate, time-bounded, and non-self-renewing; and (5) broad safety controls preserve scope separation so constraining offensive autonomy does not silently disable independently authorised bounded defensive protection.

proposal_scope.scope_summary: Add a narrow authority non-propagation subsection after ETHICS-001-SUP-03 §2.4; add defensive-necessity termination and fresh-event assessment to LATTICE-003 §2.4; add threat-signal/authority separation under LATTICE-003 conflict escalation; review the Runtime Schedule without adding military doctrine unless an actual integration gap is found.

external_relevance.external_summary: The proposal is organisation-neutral and applies wherever automated or assisted threat detection, bounded protective response, and offensive force coexist. It does not attribute the inferred failure to Israel, the IDF, any AI provider, any vendor, or any named deployed system.
